fixes.explanation: Servant is a fair guess for a man working under a king, friend, but it's not the word. Joseph says God has made him a father to Pharaoh (Genesis 45:8). Then he adds more titles: lord of all Pharaoh's household and ruler over all the land of Egypt. Nobody calls that a servant's job.

Prison is a real part of Joseph's story (Genesis 39:20), but he doesn't mention it in this message. What he tells them to pass along is “…all my splendor in Egypt and everything you have seen.” (Genesis 45:13). I bet his dad would have plenty of questions about all of it.

problems.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.
Saying Joseph wants his splendor reported first adds a priority he does not give in the passage.
